source.method: manual comparison of unit page and directly linked reference pages

configuration.availabilitySummary: May be taken in a High Elf Realms army composition list that offers Lothern Sea Guard. The unit page requires the presented configuration.

equipment.name: Mathlann's Ire
equipment.summary: In combat, one successful enemy To Hit roll against the wielder must be re-rolled.

specialRules.name: Commanding Voice
specialRules.summary: Command range 12 inches, or 15 inches when serving as General.

specialRules.name: Ithilmar Weapons
specialRules.summary: Re-roll natural To Hit rolls of 1 when fighting with a single non-magical hand weapon; does not apply to the magic weapon.

specialRules.name: Naval Discipline
specialRules.summary: A qualifying Lothern Sea Guard unit can Stand & Shoot and then redress ranks when charged, subject to listed restrictions.

specialRules.name: Rallying Cry
specialRules.summary: A character not engaged in combat may nominate a fleeing friendly unit within Command range for an additional Rally test in the Command sub-phase.

specialRules.name: Strike First
specialRules.summary: Sets Initiative to 10 during combat before other modifiers; Strike Last cancels it.

specialRules.name: Precision Strikes
specialRules.summary: Improves Armour Piercing by 1 for weapons of the Lothern Sea Guard unit that Ishaya joins.

specialRules.name: Valour of Ages
specialRules.summary: Allows re-rolls of failed Panic tests caused by heavy casualties or a friendly unit fleeing through.

interpretationChecks.summary: Combined 4+ armour value before other modifiers.
Its Strength is 5 for Ishaya's base Strength 4; Ithilmar Weapons does not apply to it.
The bonus applies to the joined Lothern Sea Guard unit, not automatically to Ishaya herself.
